array.string:
# Rename each Herdr space once to the short session title ("🗂️ TEAMKB") of its first agent pane. # Embedded here because launchd's bash got "Operation not permitted" reading a separate script file. # A space is renamed once per agent session; later manual renames are kept. set -euo pipefail
state_dir="$HOME/.local/state/herdr-space-names" state="$state_dir/renamed.tsv" # workspace_id <TAB> agent session path mkdir -p "$state_dir" touch "$state"
# Herdr not running: nothing to do. panes=$(herdr pane list 2>/dev/null) || exit 0
# workspace_id <TAB> session path of the first agent pane in each space. masters=$(jq -r ' .result.panes | map(select(.agent != null and .agent_session.kind == "path")) | group_by(.workspace_id)[] | .[0] | [.workspace_id, .agent_session.value] | @tsv' <<<"$panes")
# Drop state for spaces or sessions that no longer exist. grep -xFf <(printf '%s\n' "$masters") "$state" >"$state.tmp" || true mv "$state.tmp" "$state"
while IFS=$'\t' read -r ws session; do [ -n "$ws" ] || continue grep -qxF "$ws"$'\t'"$session" "$state" && continue # omp keeps the session title record on the first line of the session file. # Keep only the "<emoji> TAG" before the colon; titles without one stay whole. title=$(head -n1 "$session" 2>/dev/null | jq -r 'select(.type == "title") | .title // empty | sub("\\s*:.*"; "")' 2>/dev/null || true) [ -n "$title" ] || continue # title not generated yet; retry next run herdr workspace rename "$ws" "$title" >/dev/null printf '%s\t%s\n' "$ws" "$session" >>"$state" echo "$(date '+%F %T') renamed $ws -> $title" done <<<"$masters"
